assets.caption: Table 4.14 Class PAG (SR) — Piping Materials and Line Class Specification

footnotes: ( 1.) Service conditions may require heavier wall pipe and fittings.
( 2.) Nipples and swages 1-1/2 NPS and under shall be Sched 160 Min. See sub-section 3.15.
( 3.) Schedule of fittings and WN flanges to be the same as pipe schedule.
( 4.) Swages made of barstock conforming to AISI C-1025 fully killed and stress relieved with plain ends are acceptable.
( 6.) All applications of this Class must be reviewed by Shell's Materials/Corrosion Engineer.
( 7.) All flange serrations shall be to ANSI B16.5, 125-250 microinch (3.2 to 6.4 micrometres) AARH.
( 8.) Use 3/4 NPS for vent and drain service.
( 9.) Combination trim 316 SS with Stellite seats is acceptable.
( 10.) Use flanged valves on nozzles and flanged equipment or where space is limited.
( 11.) Flexible wedge is acceptable. Gate valves 3 NPS and larger in service above 150 C (300 F) shall have flexible wedge.

( 12.) Heat treated means in normalized condition. Gate valves 3 NPS and larger in service above 150 C (300 F) shall have flexible wedge. Hardness shall not exceed 187 HB. Forgings shall be stamped (N) to identify the heat-treated condition.
( 13.) Use 6000# rating when branches are Sched 160 or heavier. See sub-section 3.15.3.
( 14.) Use 2 NPS for flanged operating and instrument connections. See sub-section 3.14.
( 15.) PWHT is required at min. 620 C (1150 F). Valve bonnets, covers, gaskets, internals and trim shall be removed and tagged prior to stress relief. Reassemble with new gaskets.
( 16.) C1018 CS valve, normalized body is acceptable. Valve body shall be stamped (N) to identify normalized condition.

( 17.) Acceptable valves are: HEX HG461, Century CM9 or AGCO M5K. A long body extension may be required where the line is insulated. A gauge valve may be used only for design pressures-temperatures within its rating and only for pressure instruments installations in accordance with Shell STD. 3-1.01, Plant Piping - Design.
( 18.) Refer to Table 5.5 for the Tubing Class.
